dct_description_sm: This Voice of the People poll seeks the opinions of Canadians, on predominantly economic, political, and social issues.  The questions ask opinions of corruption in society, incidences of bribery, contributions to foreign aid and development, international organizations, and general happiness in life. There are also questions on other topics of interest such as Canadian democracy, elections, volunteering and hunger. The respondents were also asked questions so that they could be grouped according to geographic and social variables.    Topics of interest include: corruption; bribery; International Monetary Fund (IMF); World Bank (WB); foreign aid; democracy; happiness; and volunteering.   Basic demographic variables are also included.
dct_title_s: Voice of the People, 1st Edition Survey, 2008, [Canada]
